partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-001: Element forms (compound, value, list, array); children matched by name; absence not itself a refusal; unknown child skipped; refusals: NextPointeeId without Value, a repeated child of a compound element, an unknown item name in Tracks
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-002: Tracks in display order; refused without an audio, MIDI or group track, or with one of those after a return track; TrackGroupId other than -1 refused in a set without group tracks
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-003: Track Id form; Name and Color elements written
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-004: Main and cue track placement; tempo, time signature and crossfader locations; absent main or cue track replaced by a new one (tempo 120)
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-005: DeviceChain children per track kind; mixer and device list locations; AudioOut/Main in the fixtures
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-006: Scenes, session and freeze slots, slot form; Ids do not order; freeze slot count must equal session slot count; scene fields written
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-007: Clip element in the slot, kind per track, Id and Time attributes, Name held as read
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-008: SampleRef and FileRef children; RelativePathType 0 and 1; Path and Type; size, checksum, frame count and rate rules
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-009: Type 0 and 1 resolution against the set's folder (assumption); fallback to Path for 0 and 1; a missing sample does not refuse
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-010: Stored length and rate equal the file's; fixture sample form only
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-013: One send holder per return; SendsPre form; fewer holders added at -70 dB; more than R refused
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-014: Envelope locations; envelopes with PointeeId 0 or naming no target removed on opening
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-015: Target Id form; absent NextPointeeId reads 1; Id 0 or no Id refused; NextPointeeId not above the largest Id refused; absent target element tolerated
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-016: List-item Id form; negative, lettered or repeated Ids refused (assumption); Ids do not order or link
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE-018: Reference minimal set T11-MIN, whose device lists are empty, opens with the listed content; element status table

fixture_origin: generated for this release from the invented minimal set T11-MIN and one generated sine-tone WAV; each other fixture is T11-MIN with one stated change; no shipped file content, audio, schema content or program code

reviewers: separate review agent (Claude Opus 5.5) in a coordinator-launched handoff-review context; not the author; will not implement
findings: RV1-01 medium: 15 opening cases rested on the open device-placement question through T11-MIN's two devices; narrowed: devices removed from every fixture (NextPointeeId 67; case 025 uses 66; case 022 targets 67, 68 and NextPointeeId 69); assumption withdrawn; any device now has no expectation
RV1-02 low: the repeated-child refusal named every non-list element, which refused T11-MIN's KeyTrack/Notes array; arrays added as an element form; rule limited to compound elements; no case changed
RV1-03 low: REQ-009 clause 2 stated Path use for codes 2 to 7 without a case while relocation and the missing-file search are outside the release; narrowed to codes 0 and 1; no case affected
RV1-04 low: the element status table required a MIDI or audio track; restated as no audio, MIDI or group track there, in REQ-002 clause 2 and in the manifest scope; no case affected
RV1-05 low: keyed state values (send_texts, automated_parameters) now judged only for the listed track numbers; no expectation changed
RV1-06 editorial: payload status set to reviewed release; review record added; manifest fields filled
RV1-07 info: every traced open route runs the structural checks, and no read step adds freeze slots; confirmed with the stated remaining inference
RV1-08 info: every fixture expected to open passes the structural checker; each refused fixture fails only for its tested reason
review.disposition: Approved with listed narrowing and corrections, only for the explicit partial clauses; 34 cases; expectations documented, static-derived or extracted execution as labeled; reference and candidate execution not-run; restricted implementation workspace required
